mapper.select: SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId, H.CUST_ID AS custId, H.PROD_ID AS prodId, H.OPEN_STATUS AS openStatus, CC.CODE_NAME AS statusName, H.CHANGER_ID AS changerId, U.USER_NAME AS changerName, H.CHANGED_AT AS changedAt FROM TB_CUST_PROD_STATUS_HIST H LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.GROUP_CODE = 'CUST_STATUS' AND CC.CODE_VALUE = H.OPEN_STATUS AND (CC.USE_YN IS NULL OR CC.USE_YN = 'Y') LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = H.CHANGER_ID WHERE H.CUST_ID = #{custId} ORDER BY H.CHANGED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CUST_PROD_STATUS_HIST (CUST_ID, PROD_ID, OPEN_STATUS, CHANGER_ID) VALUES (#{custId}, #{prodId}, #{openStatus}, #{changerId})
